notes.title: Content Update 1 - RC-Cars on the moon & on the soccerfield!
notes.notes:
CHARGED: RC Racing Update 1.4 comes with the first content update!
A new race in the expert cup brings your RC Cars to the moon! But don't worry, you can stay on earth!
The new Minigame Mode RC-Soccer can now be unlocked. Play Soccer with your RC-Car in 2 teams with each 2 cars on 3 different arenas!


ːsteamthisːContent Update 1ːsteamthisː:

 new moon race track on expert cup
 RC-Soccer mode with 3 arenas

 increased difficulty
 horn function
 enable / disable HUD
 new item sounds
 track arrows



FIXED in UPDATE 1.4:
